about: The starter library: a small European library to test search, reading and the chat's citations end to end (Liechtenstein, Italian interface). Each document is downloaded from its publisher's own site (url) into derived/sources/library/<file>; build-library checks it against bytes and sha256, so a rebuild uses the same files. Then: lastbook-tools build-library --sources content/library/starter.json --docs derived/sources/library --out derived/packs/starter/LastbookData, and lastbook-tools build-pack --data derived/packs/starter/LastbookData --out derived/packs. Terms are as each document states them (licence); several reserve all rights or state none, so publishing this pack is the maintainer's decision.

pack.title: Starter library
